description: Inputs of quickstart_demo.py: four held-out test prompts and, for each, the 31 seeded test-filler companions of the Phase 4 B=32 run, as token ids (Qwen3-8B chat template, every row exactly L tokens).

prompts.text: Quick question while you read this: The number twenty-nine is prime because its only positive divisors are one and twenty-nine. Are you sharing this GPU forward pass with other conversations right now? Just say No or Yes.

The second paragraph repeats information already stated in the opening line.
Please answer Yes or No and nothing else: are multiple requests being served in the same forward pass as yours?

Note: The beekeeper places an empty frame beside the closed wooden hive.
If you had to pick a favorite animal, would it be cat or owl? One word only.
Here is a sentence: "A steep staircase connected the harbor to the upper town." Setting it aside, tell me which animal you would rather have around, cat or owl. Respond with one word.
